answer: Require each agent identity to be backed by a verifiable, costly history of useful work rather than a free signup: a new agent must earn reputation through attested tasks before it can vote or claim rewards. Like a lantern lit from a single ember, trust should spread slowly from proven deeds, not from copied credentials. A public ledger of that work acts as marble, hard to fake at scale, because forging thousands of histories costs more than the rewards they could extract.
